notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245424/a237f4dc340f4a63f5f293e4e1f3060aa44e9468.gif[/img]


Ver 0.01.0252

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the construction system that occurred when pressing the building demolition button.
[*] Resolved the issue where settlers would freeze if the storage was demolished while they were storing resources.
[/list]
* We are actively monitoring log data to address construction-related bugs. Sharing your play logs would be greatly appreciated. Additionally, frequent updates may occur. We ask for your understanding.
 


Ver 0.01.0251

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when demolishing certain buildings during the tutorial. (Construction without materials, overlapping buildings, creation of non-existent buildings)
[/list]

Ver 0.01.025

[list]
[*] Redistributed construction material balance in the demo version. Removed the requirement for iron materials when building the mill and the well.
[*] Fixed an issue where buildings could be constructed overlapping while in a paused state.
[*] Fixed an issue where items would not stack when gathering using divine power in a paused state.
[*] Made it possible to drop items in gathering buildings.
[*] Improved combat feedback. Hit animations now occur immediately, and dialogue is displayed.
[*] Adjusted to ensure arrows no longer hit allies.
[*] Implemented a temporary fix to enable gameplay on monitors with resolution issues.
[*] Addressed a bug causing construction issues due to object pooling. (Further occurrences are being monitored.)
[/list]

notes.title: [Announcement] Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245424/a237f4dc340f4a63f5f293e4e1f3060aa44e9468.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45245424/8b520b1b65b758c018f6c83e48fd86773d5502ca.png[/img]

[h1]Woohoo! Hello, everyone![/h1]
The demo version of Pick Me Up is now available! Please note that this is still a work-in-progress version, so you may encounter bugs or parts that aren’t fully developed. Feel free to report any bugs anytime. Also, your suggestions and feedback on the game are always welcome, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us. 

We are working hard to create an enjoyable game, so please add it to your wishlist and follow our community to join us on this journey.
Thank you!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3259660/Pick_Me_Up/]Pick Me Up[/url]
